canonical.title: Vite build fails on case-sensitive import
canonical.body: The import used ./Foo but the file is foo.tsx; works on macOS, fails in CI.
canonical.author: devon

note: resolve_duplicate returns the write envelope of the final outcome (design/07). `merge_into` is required when resolution == 'merge' (07's per-argument table; dedup.py's own guard) and names the node the parked write is absorbed into -- here the canonical this envelope reports. It was missing until 2026-07-21, when the wire-enforcement build's fixture-acceptance loop replayed these arguments for the first time and this pair proved impossible; ruled then that the fixture was the wrong artifact, since 07's table and the shipped code already agreed.
